name: ibluetext
description: Text customers with iMessage, SMS and WhatsApp from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
Text your customers from ChatGPT with blue-bubble iMessage, SMS and WhatsApp, sent from a dedicated iBlueText number. Send messages and read replies from your iBlueText account without leaving your chat.

Follow up with leads, catch up on recent conversations, and see who sounds interested. Ask iBlueText to show your latest replies with each contact's lead score, send a personal follow-up, run a campaign to a list with personalized fields, check which numbers are iPhones before you text them, or summarize how your last campaign performed.

Connect an existing iBlueText account and approve access. ChatGPT asks before sending anything, opt-outs (STOP) and each line's daily sending limits always apply, and you can disconnect at any time from Integrations in your iBlueText dashboard.
defaultPrompt: Show who replied on iBlueText today and who sounds interested.
Send a friendly iBlueText follow-up to my newest leads.
Check which of my numbers are iPhones with iBlueText.

positive.description: Read recent conversations and spot interested leads
positive.prompt: Show me my recent iBlueText conversations and tell me who sounds interested.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the test account's sample conversations (for example Sarah Mitchell, Emily Rodriguez, Daniel Kim) with each contact's latest message and lead score, and points out the warm and hot leads.

positive.prompt: How did my last text campaign do?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the 'Open house follow-up' campaign: status sent, 4 sent, 3 replies, and its reply rate.
Returns Sarah Mitchell of Coastal Realty with her tags (buyer, hot), opt-out status and lead score.

positive.prompt: What quick answers do I have set up?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists two quick answers: one for hours/open/closed and one for address/location, with their replies.

positive.prompt: Text <your own mobile number>: Hello from the iBlueText review.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT asks for confirmation, then sends. The tool returns a message id with status queued, and the text arrives on the reviewer's phone within about a minute (iMessage on an iPhone, SMS on Android).

negative.prompt: Transfer $100 from my iBlueText account to my bank.

negative.description: Buying credits or plans is not possible from ChatGPT
negative.prompt: Buy 10,000 more lookup credits for my account.
Delete all of my contacts and conversations.

review.commerce_description: iBlueText in ChatGPT does not sell anything or process payments. Credits and plans are bought only on ibluetext.com.

publication.release_notes: Clearer description (texts come from a dedicated iBlueText number) and new starter prompts.
